en.text: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

zhSimplified.text: 因此我心战兢， 从原处移动。

zhTraditional.text: 因此我心戰兢， 從原處移動。

en.text: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 听啊， 神轰轰的声音 是他口中所发的响声。

zhTraditional.text: 聽啊，上帝轟轟的聲音 是他口中所發的響聲。

en.text: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 他发响声震遍天下， 发电光闪到地极。

zhTraditional.text: 他發響聲震遍天下， 發電光閃到地極。

en.text: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

zhSimplified.text: 随后人听见有雷声轰轰，大发威严， 雷电接连不断。

zhTraditional.text: 隨後人聽見有雷聲轟轟，大發威嚴， 雷電接連不斷。

en.text: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

zhSimplified.text: 神发出奇妙的雷声； 他行大事，我们不能测透。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝發出奇妙的雷聲； 他行大事，我們不能測透。

en.text: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

zhSimplified.text: 他对雪说：要降在地上； 对大雨和暴雨也是这样说。

zhTraditional.text: 他對雪說：要降在地上； 對大雨和暴雨也是這樣說。

en.text: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

zhSimplified.text: 他封住各人的手， 叫所造的万人都晓得他的作为。

zhTraditional.text: 他封住各人的手， 叫所造的萬人都曉得他的作為。

en.text: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

zhSimplified.text: 百兽进入穴中， 卧在洞内。

zhTraditional.text: 百獸進入穴中， 臥在洞內。

en.text: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

zhSimplified.text: 暴风出于南宫； 寒冷出于北方。

zhTraditional.text: 暴風出於南宮； 寒冷出於北方。

en.text: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

zhSimplified.text: 神嘘气成冰； 宽阔之水也都凝结。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝噓氣成冰； 寬闊之水也都凝結。

en.text: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

zhSimplified.text: 他使密云盛满水气， 布散电光之云；

zhTraditional.text: 他使密雲盛滿水氣， 布散電光之雲；

en.text: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

zhSimplified.text: 这云是借他的指引游行旋转， 得以在全地面上行他一切所吩咐的，

zhTraditional.text: 這雲是藉他的指引游行旋轉， 得以在全地面上行他一切所吩咐的，

en.text: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

zhSimplified.text: 或为责罚，或为润地， 或为施行慈爱。

zhTraditional.text: 或為責罰，或為潤地， 或為施行慈愛。

en.text: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

zhSimplified.text: 约伯啊，你要留心听， 要站立思想 神奇妙的作为。

zhTraditional.text: 約伯啊，你要留心聽， 要站立思想上帝奇妙的作為。

en.text: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

zhSimplified.text: 神如何吩咐这些， 如何使云中的电光照耀，你知道吗？

zhTraditional.text: 上帝如何吩咐這些， 如何使雲中的電光照耀，你知道嗎？

en.text: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

zhSimplified.text: 云彩如何浮于空中， 那知识全备者奇妙的作为，你知道吗？

zhTraditional.text: 雲彩如何浮於空中， 那知識全備者奇妙的作為，你知道嗎？

en.text: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

zhSimplified.text: 南风使地寂静， 你的衣服就如火热，你知道吗？

zhTraditional.text: 南風使地寂靜， 你的衣服就如火熱，你知道嗎？

en.text: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

zhSimplified.text: 你岂能与 神同铺穹苍吗？ 这穹苍坚硬，如同铸成的镜子。

zhTraditional.text: 你豈能與上帝同鋪穹蒼嗎？ 這穹蒼堅硬，如同鑄成的鏡子。

en.text: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

zhSimplified.text: 我们愚昧不能陈说； 请你指教我们该对他说什么话。

zhTraditional.text: 我們愚昧不能陳說； 請你指教我們該對他說甚麼話。

en.text: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

zhSimplified.text: 人岂可说：我愿与他说话？ 岂有人自愿灭亡吗？

zhTraditional.text: 人豈可說：我願與他說話？ 豈有人自願滅亡嗎？

en.text: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

zhSimplified.text: 现在有云遮蔽，人不得见穹苍的光亮； 但风吹过，天又发晴。

zhTraditional.text: 現在有雲遮蔽，人不得見穹蒼的光亮； 但風吹過，天又發晴。

en.text: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

zhSimplified.text: 金光出于北方， 在 神那里有可怕的威严。

zhTraditional.text: 金光出於北方， 在上帝那裏有可怕的威嚴。

en.text: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

zhSimplified.text: 论到全能者，我们不能测度； 他大有能力，有公平和大义， 必不苦待人。

zhTraditional.text: 論到全能者，我們不能測度； 他大有能力，有公平和大義， 必不苦待人。

en.text: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”

zhSimplified.text: 所以，人敬畏他； 凡自以为心中有智慧的人，他都不顾念。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，人敬畏他； 凡自以為心中有智慧的人，他都不顧念。
